name: Silk Hatchling
shortDescription: A silk-child that woke too early and will not wait.
lookDescription: A pale hatchling, no larger than a satchel, clicking among the opened husks.
examineDescription: The Silk Hatchling is the size of a school satchel. Its legs are still soft, but the mandibles already click like a practice stick. Piper is afraid of it for a reason. Finish it. It is not a queen, and it should not get back up.
